name: Default Quality Rules
description: Standard BIM model quality checks for naming, parameters, and model health.

rules.name: Wall Naming Convention
rules.description: Wall type names must not be default/unnamed (e.g., 'Wall 1', 'Generic'). Should describe material or function.

parameters.violationMessage: '{0}' is a default wall name — rename to describe material or function

rules.name: Level Naming Convention
rules.description: Level names must not be Revit defaults like 'Level 1'. Should have a meaningful name.

parameters.violationMessage: '{0}' is a default Revit level name
parameters.suggestedFix: Rename to something meaningful (e.g. 'Ground Floor', '1st Floor')

rules.name: View Naming Convention
rules.description: View names must not contain default suffixes like 'Copy', 'Kopya', or auto-numbered sections.

parameters.violationMessage: '{0}' contains a default or copy suffix
parameters.suggestedFix: Rename with a descriptive view name (e.g. 'A101 - Ground Floor Plan')

rules.name: Room Naming Convention
rules.description: Room names must not be Revit defaults like 'Room' or empty.

rules.name: Door Naming Convention
rules.description: Door type names must not be generic defaults.

parameters.violationMessage: '{0}' is a default door type name
parameters.suggestedFix: Rename to describe the door (e.g. 'Single Flush 900x2100')

rules.name: Fire Rating Required
rules.description: All walls should have a Fire Rating parameter filled in for code compliance.

rules.name: Mark Required for Doors
rules.description: All doors must have a Mark parameter for scheduling.

rules.name: Room Number Required
rules.description: All rooms must have a Number parameter for area schedules.

rules.name: Window Mark Required
rules.description: All windows must have a Mark parameter for scheduling.

rules.name: Duplicate View Names
rules.description: Detects views with identical names (indicates unorganized views).

rules.name: Unplaced Rooms
rules.description: Detects rooms with zero area (unplaced or with open boundaries).

rules.name: Duplicate Room Numbers
rules.description: Detects rooms sharing the same Number value.

rules.name: Missing Room Tags
rules.description: Detects rooms that have no tag placed in any view.

parameters.violationMessage: Room has no tag placed in any view
parameters.suggestedFix: Place a room tag in a floor plan view

rules.name: Missing Door Tags
rules.description: Detects doors that have no tag placed in any view.

parameters.violationMessage: Door has no tag placed in any view
parameters.suggestedFix: Place a door tag in a floor plan view

rules.name: Unjoined Walls
rules.description: Detects walls with disallowed joins at one or both ends.

parameters.violationMessage: Wall join is disallowed at one or both ends
parameters.suggestedFix: Right-click wall end and select 'Allow Join'
